paragraphs.en: Beating latent diffusion models with pixel-space encoder-decoders
paragraphs.zh: 用像素空间编码器-解码器击败潜在扩散模型

paragraphs.en: Linum v2 was bottlenecked by the enormous size of its attention context window. A 720p, 5 second clip cost a whopping 110K tokens. To put that in perspective, LLMs see samples with fewer than 8K tokens for 97% of their pretraining . Attention is quadratic in cost, so the biggest lever we have to accelerate model training is pruning the context window down.
paragraphs.zh: Linum v2 的瓶颈在于其注意力上下文窗口的巨大规模。 一段 720p、5 秒的视频剪辑就要消耗高达 11 万个 token。 作为对比，大语言模型在 97% 的预训练中所见样本的 token 数低于 8K。 注意力的计算成本是平方级的，因此加速模型训练的最大杠杆就是把上下文窗口裁剪得更小。

paragraphs.en: Most generative image and video systems are Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs). They split compression and generation into independently trained modules: the Variational Autoencoder (VAE) and the DiT (Diffusion Transformer). Recently, pixel-space models like the JiT have shown to be a promising alternative. It reduces two models into one and allows the diffusion model to construct a latent space specifically for generation, rather than rely on one built for reconstruction.
paragraphs.zh: 大多数生成式图像和视频系统都是潜在扩散模型（LDM）。 它们将压缩和生成分割为独立训练的两个模块：变分自编码器（VAE）和 DiT（扩散 Transformer）。 最近，像 JiT 这样的像素空间模型已被证明是一种有前景的替代方案。 它将两个模型合并为一个，并允许扩散模型构建一个专门用于生成的潜在空间，而不是依赖于一个为重建而构建的潜在空间。

paragraphs.en: When trained on our (image, caption) dataset, the JiT seems to struggle to produce finegrained details. We propose a novel encoder-decoder architecture (JiT-DDT) that recovers this detail and trains much more efficiently than its LDM counterpart. Against our Linum v2 baseline, the JiT-DDT trains a text-to-image model with 3.6× fewer GPU-hours, even though it generates images with 4× the pixels.
paragraphs.zh: 当在我们的（图像，描述）数据集上训练时，JiT似乎难以生成细粒度的细节。 我们提出了一种新颖的编码器-解码器架构（JiT-DDT），它能够恢复这些细节，并且训练效率远高于其对应的LDM。 相比我们的Linum v2基线，JiT-DDT训练一个文本到图像模型所需的GPU小时数减少3.6倍，尽管它生成的图像像素数是其4倍。

paragraphs.en: Almost all generative image and video models are Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs). These have two key components, a Variational Auto Encoder (VAE) for compression and a Diffusion Transformer (DiT) for generation.
paragraphs.zh: 几乎所有的生成式图像和视频模型都是潜在扩散模型（Latent Diffusion Models, LDM）。 它们包含两个关键组件：用于压缩的变分自编码器（Variational Auto Encoder, VAE）和用于生成的扩散Transformer（Diffusion Transformer, DiT）。

sents.en: Almost all generative image and video models are Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs).
sents.zh: 几乎所有的生成式图像和视频模型都是潜在扩散模型（Latent Diffusion Models, LDM）。

sents.en: These have two key components, a Variational Auto Encoder (VAE) for compression and a Diffusion Transformer (DiT) for generation.
sents.zh: 它们包含两个关键组件：用于压缩的变分自编码器（Variational Auto Encoder, VAE）和用于生成的扩散Transformer（Diffusion Transformer, DiT）。

paragraphs.en: Operating in raw pixels is too expensive (especially for video), so we first need to find a way to reduce RGB pixels into a smaller amount of tokens for the DiT. This is where the VAE comes in. It's trained for compression and reconstruction. Specifically, it pushes our pixel-space samples through a probabilistic encoder, spits out -dimensional tokens, and then pushes these latent tokens through a probabilistic decoder to land back in pixel-space.
paragraphs.zh: 直接在原始像素上操作代价太高（尤其是视频），所以我们首先需要找到一种方法，把 RGB 像素缩减为更少量的 token，供 DiT 使用。 这正是 VAE 发挥作用的地方。 它通过压缩与重建来训练。 具体来说，它把像素空间的样本送入一个概率编码器，输出 - 维的 token，然后再把这些潜在 token 送入一个概率解码器，映射回像素空间。

sents.en: Operating in raw pixels is too expensive (especially for video), so we first need to find a way to reduce RGB pixels into a smaller amount of tokens for the DiT.
sents.zh: 直接在原始像素上操作代价太高（尤其是视频），所以我们首先需要找到一种方法，把 RGB 像素缩减为更少量的 token，供 DiT 使用。

sents.en: This is where the VAE comes in.
sents.zh: 这正是 VAE 发挥作用的地方。

sents.en: It's trained for compression and reconstruction.
sents.zh: 它通过压缩与重建来训练。

sents.en: Specifically, it pushes our pixel-space samples through a probabilistic encoder, spits out -dimensional tokens, and then pushes these latent tokens through a probabilistic decoder to land back in pixel-space.
sents.zh: 具体来说，它把像素空间的样本送入一个概率编码器，输出 - 维的 token，然后再把这些潜在 token 送入一个概率解码器，映射回像素空间。

paragraphs.en: The VAE is trained to compress and reconstruct
paragraphs.zh: 该变分自编码器（VAE）经过训练以进行压缩和重建。

paragraphs.en: When building a LDM, you train the VAE separately and then freeze it (i.e. no gradient flow from the DiT into the VAE). This way the latent space stays static throughout the course of DiT training. You run the VAE's encoder to embed your data, train the DiT to traverse the VAE's latent space, and then transform the DiT-generated latent tokens into pixel space using the VAE's decoder.
paragraphs.zh: 构建潜在扩散模型（LDM）时，你会先单独训练 VAE，然后将其冻结（即不让梯度从 DiT 流入 VAE）。 这样一来，潜在空间在整个 DiT 训练过程中保持静态。 你运行 VAE 的编码器来嵌入数据，训练 DiT 在 VAE 的潜在空间中漫游，然后使用 VAE 的解码器将 DiT 生成的潜在 token 变换到像素空间。

sents.en: When building a LDM, you train the VAE separately and then freeze it (i.e. no gradient flow from the DiT into the VAE).
sents.zh: 构建潜在扩散模型（LDM）时，你会先单独训练 VAE，然后将其冻结（即不让梯度从 DiT 流入 VAE）。

sents.en: This way the latent space stays static throughout the course of DiT training.
sents.zh: 这样一来，潜在空间在整个 DiT 训练过程中保持静态。

sents.en: You run the VAE's encoder to embed your data, train the DiT to traverse the VAE's latent space, and then transform the DiT-generated latent tokens into pixel space using the VAE's decoder.
sents.zh: 你运行 VAE 的编码器来嵌入数据，训练 DiT 在 VAE 的潜在空间中漫游，然后使用 VAE 的解码器将 DiT 生成的潜在 token 变换到像素空间。

paragraphs.en: The VAE is trained once and frozen; the DiT learns to move through its latent space
paragraphs.zh: VAE 只训练一次并被冻结；DiT 则学习在其潜空间中移动

paragraphs.en: We want to eke out as much token compression as possible from the VAE, so that we can curb the cost of attention in our DiT. But if you take a survey of the popular open source text-to-image models like FLUX, Ideogram, and Z-Image, you'll notice that they all cap out at 16×16 token reduction. This aligns with our experiments on Image-Video VAEs from a few years ago . Unfortunately, it seems like there is an empirical ceiling on the amount of compression we can get out of a standard CNN VAE without degrading the reconstructions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们希望从 VAE 中尽可能榨取更多的 token 压缩，以便控制 DiT 中注意力机制的开销。 但如果你调查一下流行的开源文生图模型，比如 FLUX、Ideogram 和 Z-Image，你会注意到它们的 token 缩减上限都是 16×16。 这与我们几年前对图像-视频 VAE 的实验结果一致。 遗憾的是，在不降低重建质量的前提下，标准 CNN VAE 能提供的压缩量似乎存在一个经验上限。

sents.en: We want to eke out as much token compression as possible from the VAE, so that we can curb the cost of attention in our DiT.
sents.zh: 我们希望从 VAE 中尽可能榨取更多的 token 压缩，以便控制 DiT 中注意力机制的开销。

sents.en: But if you take a survey of the popular open source text-to-image models like FLUX, Ideogram, and Z-Image, you'll notice that they all cap out at 16×16 token reduction.

sents.zh: 这与我们几年前对图像-视频 VAE 的实验结果一致。

sents.zh: 遗憾的是，在不降低重建质量的前提下，标准 CNN VAE 能提供的压缩量似乎存在一个经验上限。

paragraphs.en: Last fall, Tianhong Li and Kaiming He published a paper ( JiT ) that achieves 32×32 token reduction by throwing away the VAE altogether and pushing the compression task into the DiT itself.
paragraphs.zh: 去年秋天，田洪立（Tianhong Li）和何恺明（Kaiming He）发表了一篇论文（JiT），该论文通过完全舍弃 VAE 并将压缩任务推入 DiT 本身，实现了 32×32 的 token 压缩。

paragraphs.en: Patchify: 4×4-pixel patches → 48-dim tokens → linear bottleneck to 12
paragraphs.zh: Patchify：4×4 像素块 → 48 维 token → 线性瓶颈层降至 12

paragraphs.en: each patch is tokenized independently: 16 pixels × 3 channels become one 48-dim token
paragraphs.zh: 每个图像块被独立分词：16 个像素 × 3 个通道变成一个 48 维 token

paragraphs.en: a linear layer W ∈ ℝ 12 × 48 projects 48 dims down to 12
paragraphs.zh: 一个线性层 W ∈ ℝ 12 × 48 将 48 维投影降为 12 维

paragraphs.en: This approach to reducing token counts isn't particularly new. It was invented for vision transformers ( ViT ) half a decade ago, and it's pretty commonly paired with a VAE to further condense token sequences before they enter the DiT. In Linum v2, our VAE gave us 8×8 (h×w) compression and 16-dimensional latents. At the base of the DiT, we applied 2×2 patchification to get 16×16 token compression and 64-dimensional latents. We used it in Linum v2 and so do models like FLUX.
paragraphs.zh: 这种减少 token 数量的方法并不是特别新颖。 它在大约五年前就被发明用于视觉 Transformer（ViT），并且通常与 VAE 搭配使用，在 token 序列进入 DiT 之前进一步压缩。 在 Linum v2 中，我们的 VAE 提供了 8×8（高×宽）的压缩和 16 维的潜变量。 在 DiT 的底层，我们应用了 2×2 的 patch 化，从而实现 16×16 的 token 压缩和 64 维的潜变量。 我们在 Linum v2 中使用了它，FLUX 等模型也是如此。

sents.en: This approach to reducing token counts isn't particularly new.
sents.zh: 这种减少 token 数量的方法并不是特别新颖。

sents.en: It was invented for vision transformers ( ViT ) half a decade ago, and it's pretty commonly paired with a VAE to further condense token sequences before they enter the DiT.

paragraphs.en: In early 2025, papers like VA-VAE demonstrated that DiTs struggle to learn from high dimensional inputs. There are small hacks like using an external model as a regularizer during VAE training (e.g. DINOv3) that (likely) enabled models like FLUX-2 to make the leap from 64 latent dimensions to 128 latent dimensions for their DiT. But, these strategies just kick the can down the road on a clear learnability problem within the DiT. Aggressive patchification explicitly pushes information into the channel dimension, so it triggers this instability. But as it turns out, this is not intrinsic to the architecture. Rather, it's downstream of the v-prediction, v-loss flow matching objective that everyone's been using to train diffusion models these past few years.
paragraphs.zh: 2025年初，像 VA-VAE 这样的论文表明，扩散变换器（DiT）难以从高维输入中学习。 也有一些小技巧，比如在 VAE 训练过程中使用外部模型作为正则化器（例如 DINOv3），（很可能）正是这些技巧让 FLUX-2 等模型的 DiT 得以从 64 个潜在维度跃升到 128 个潜在维度。 但这些策略只是把问题往后推，并没有解决 DiT 内部一个明确的可学习性问题。 激进的分块处理（patchification）明确地把信息推入通道维度，因此会触发这种不稳定性。 但事实证明，这并非该架构本身固有的问题。 相反，它是 v-预测、v-损失的流匹配目标所导致的下游结果，而过去几年大家一直在用这个目标来训练扩散模型。

paragraphs.en: In old school 2022-era denoising diffusion ( DDPM ), we iteratively noise a sample and train a neural network to remove the noise. This way at inference time we can use our neural network to transform Gaussian noise into a sample from our data distribution over a sequence of steps. This formulation has a host of issues (e.g. oversaturation in generation , unstable learning , distillation collapse ), so in the intervening years the field has shifted away from it towards flow matching.
paragraphs.zh: 在老派的2022年时代去噪扩散（DDPM）中，我们对样本迭代地加噪，并训练一个神经网络来去除噪声。 这样，在推理时我们可以利用神经网络，通过一系列步骤将高斯噪声转换为我们数据分布中的一个样本。 这种表述存在诸多问题（例如生成过度饱和、学习不稳定、蒸馏崩塌），因此在随后的几年里，该领域已逐渐放弃它，转向流匹配。

sents.en: In old school 2022-era denoising diffusion ( DDPM ), we iteratively noise a sample and train a neural network to remove the noise.
sents.zh: 在老派的2022年时代去噪扩散（DDPM）中，我们对样本迭代地加噪，并训练一个神经网络来去除噪声。

sents.en: This way at inference time we can use our neural network to transform Gaussian noise into a sample from our data distribution over a sequence of steps.
sents.zh: 这样，在推理时我们可以利用神经网络，通过一系列步骤将高斯噪声转换为我们数据分布中的一个样本。

sents.en: This formulation has a host of issues (e.g. oversaturation in generation , unstable learning , distillation collapse ), so in the intervening years the field has shifted away from it towards flow matching.

paragraphs.en: In flow matching , we construct a straight line path between every sample in our data distribution and a sample of Gaussian noise: The path between noise and samples does not have to be straight. But in practice, we all do it.

paragraphs.en: In JiT, Li and He revisited the v-prediction, v-loss decision that the field's been making since the inception of flow matching. They took a toy distribution (points on a spiral) and then projected these points from 2D to different high dimensional spaces of increasing size. For each of these spaces, they trained flow matching models with x-prediction, -prediction, and velocity-prediction; and found that the x-prediction was the only model type to accurately generate samples from the spiral distribution at large dimensions. DiTs have been struggling to learn from high-dimensional inputs because of the curse of dimensionality.

paragraphs.zh: 当我们读到 JiT 时，我们非常兴奋地想试一试，因为它明确能够实现 32×32 的 token 缩减。 但是，如果说这是实现这种压缩水平的唯一方法，那就不够严谨了。 或者说，也并非所有人都认同这是实现这种压缩程度的最佳方法。

sents.zh: 或者说，也并非所有人都认同这是实现这种压缩程度的最佳方法。

paragraphs.en: LTX has been able to do this in their video models by altering their VAE's decoder to make it an explicit denoiser (i.e. they finetune the VAE decoder with a flow matching objective). More recently, Minimax H3 has achieved 32×32 compression in their VAE by swapping out the standard ~80-150M parameter CNN Decoder with a 2B parameter transformer (roughly the size of our entire Linum v2 model). And on toy benchmarks like ImageNet, LDMs still out-perform pixel space models by a smidge. Nevertheless, we think we can overcome some of the limitations present in the original JiT paper and match LDMs' performance in generative image and video.
paragraphs.zh: LTX 之所以能做到这一点，是通过修改其视频模型的 VAE 解码器，使其成为一个显式的去噪器（即他们用流匹配目标对 VAE 解码器进行了微调）。 最近，Minimax H3 通过将标准的约 8000 万至 1.5 亿参数的 CNN 解码器替换为一个 2B 参数的 transformer（大致相当于我们整个 Linum v2 模型的规模），在其 VAE 中实现了 32×32 的压缩。 而在 ImageNet 这类玩具基准上，LDM（潜在扩散模型）的表现仍然略胜于像素空间模型。 尽管如此，我们认为我们能够克服原始 JiT 论文中存在的一些局限性，并在生成式图像和视频任务上达到 LDM 的性能水平。

paragraphs.en: Ideologically, we believe simple tends to beat complex when it comes to training neural networks at scale. Papers like E2E-VAE from last fall have shown that allowing your DiT to backpropagate (smartly) into the VAE can improve generation results and accelerate convergence dramatically.
paragraphs.zh: 在理念上，我们相信在规模化训练神经网络时，简单往往胜过复杂。 去年秋天的 E2E-VAE 等论文已经表明，允许 DiT（巧妙地）向 VAE 进行反向传播，可以显著改善生成结果并大幅加速收敛。

paragraphs.en: To us, it makes logical sense that if we can specifically tailor the "latent space" for generation rather than rely on one built for compression, we can get better results. And we get the added benefit of having one cohesive model, rather than two disjoint ones.

paragraphs.en: Instead of alternating blocks of self-attention (image/video) and cross-attention (text-to-image/video), we concatenate visual tokens and text tokens into a single stream that goes through the DiT. This increases the attention sequence in every block and increases the FLOPs per token, but should allow for significantly more expressive relationships between text and image tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 我们不再交替使用自注意力（图像/视频）与交叉注意力（文本到图像/视频）模块，而是将视觉 token 和文本 token 拼接成单一序列，送入 DiT 处理。 这会增加每个模块中的注意力序列长度，并提高每个 token 的浮点运算量（FLOPs），但应能实现文本与图像 token 之间更具表现力的关联。

paragraphs.en: When you train a VAE, you use perceptual losses like LPIPS and adversarial loss via a GAN to push the reconstructions towards what humans like. MSE on its own gives you a blurry mess. Now that we don't have a VAE decoder, we need the JiT itself to leverage these losses to generate stuff humans like. We still use LPIPS , but instead of a GAN we use a P-DINO loss . Both are only applied when .

paragraphs.en: Moonshot's Kimi models proved that the Muon optimizer works really well at scale . As they recommend, all the 2D matrices in our network (e.g. q/k/v matrices for attention, FFN weights) are optimized with Muon , while layers at the input/output of the network (e.g. patchification, output head) and scales/biases (e.g. AdaLN) are still optimized by AdamW.
paragraphs.zh: Moonshot 的 Kimi 模型证明了 Muon 优化器在大规模场景下确实非常好用。 按照他们的建议，我们网络中所有的二维矩阵（例如注意力机制的 q/k/v 矩阵、FFN 权重）都用 Muon 优化，而位于网络输入/输出端的层（例如图像分块、输出头）以及缩放因子/偏置（例如 AdaLN）仍然由 AdamW 优化。

paragraphs.en: It's become pretty common to accelerate the convergence of your DiT by having an earlier layer in the network (e.g. layer 8 of a 23-layer transformer) align to the embedding of in an auxiliary model (e.g. DINOv3). This technique is referred to as REPresentation Alignment (REPA). We'll dig into this (and the limitations) later in the blog, so hold on for that. But for now, plain REPA did not work well for the JiT. Instead, we adopted PixelREPA which masks out x% of tokens in our visual token hidden state, pushes it through a shallow transformer, and then applies the typical cosine-distance loss between all visual tokens (including the masked tokens) and the auxiliary representation from DINOv3.
paragraphs.zh: 通过让网络中较早的层（例如23层transformer的第8层）与辅助模型（例如DINOv3）的嵌入对齐，来加速DiT的收敛，这种做法已经相当普遍。 这种技术被称为表征对齐（REPA）。 我们会在博客后面深入探讨这一点（以及它的局限性），请稍候。 但目前来看，普通的REPA在JiT上效果并不好。 取而代之的是，我们采用了PixelREPA：它在视觉token隐藏状态中掩蔽掉x%的token，将其通过一个浅层智能体transformer，然后在所有视觉token（包括被掩蔽的token）与来自DINOv3的辅助表征之间施加通常的余弦距离损失。

sents.en: Instead, we adopted PixelREPA which masks out x% of tokens in our visual token hidden state, pushes it through a shallow transformer, and then applies the typical cosine-distance loss between all visual tokens (including the masked tokens) and the auxiliary representation from DINOv3.

paragraphs.en: DINOv3 uses 16×16 patches. We need the token count between the DINO representation and our hidden state to match, so we downsample the images before they go through DINO. For example, if we're doing a 32×32 patchification on 512×512 images, we will have 256 tokens. We downsample the image to 256×256 before passing it through DINO's 16×16 patchification to also get 256 tokens.
paragraphs.zh: DINOv3 使用 16×16 的图像块（patch）。 我们需要让 DINO 表示与我们隐藏状态之间的 token 数量相匹配，因此在图像进入 DINO 之前先对其进行下采样。 例如，如果我们在 512×512 的图像上进行 32×32 的图像块划分，我们将得到 256 个 token。 我们把图像下采样到 256×256，再经过 DINO 的 16×16 图像块划分，同样得到 256 个 token。

sents.en: DINOv3 uses 16×16 patches.
sents.zh: DINOv3 使用 16×16 的图像块（patch）。

paragraphs.en: Now that we're moving from a cross-attention to a single-stream DiT architecture, we may be at a higher risk of attention sinks . We adopt sigmoid attention gating to neutralize this issue.
paragraphs.zh: 由于我们现在从交叉注意力架构转向单流 DiT 架构，我们可能面临更高的注意力汇（attention sinks）风险。 我们采用 sigmoid 注意力门控来消除这一问题。

sents.en: Now that we're moving from a cross-attention to a single-stream DiT architecture, we may be at a higher risk of attention sinks .
sents.zh: 由于我们现在从交叉注意力架构转向单流 DiT 架构，我们可能面临更高的注意力汇（attention sinks）风险。

sents.en: We adopt sigmoid attention gating to neutralize this issue.
sents.zh: 我们采用 sigmoid 注意力门控来消除这一问题。

paragraphs.en: attention gate · 23 gates per block (1 for each attention head) · elementwise multiply
paragraphs.zh: 注意力门控 · 每个块 23 个门控（每个注意力头 1 个）· 逐元素相乘

paragraphs.en: Instead of T5-XXL text embeddings, we use hidden states from a more modern decoder-only LLM, Qwen3.5-4B. One downside to using a LLM is that it's unclear what hidden state to take as your embedding. Most modern LLMs use some sort of alternating sequence of sparse/linear attention and full-attention. We take the hidden states calculated after full-attention blocks, concatenate them together, and have the DiT learn a transform to combine these representations into a single text condition. Recent Ideogram and FLUX models are more aggressive here, using larger LLMs and aggregating information across all hidden states. Given the size of our DiT, it seemed like overkill to go down that path.
paragraphs.zh: 我们没有使用 T5-XXL 文本嵌入，而是使用了来自更现代的 decoder-only 大语言模型 Qwen3.5-4B 的隐藏状态。 使用大语言模型的一个缺点是，不清楚应该取哪个隐藏状态作为嵌入。 大多数现代大语言模型都采用某种稀疏/线性注意力与全注意力交替的序列结构。 我们取全注意力块之后计算得到的隐藏状态，将它们拼接在一起，并让 DiT 学习一个变换，把这些表示组合成单一的文本条件。 最近的 Ideogram 和 FLUX 模型在这方面更为激进，使用更大的大语言模型并跨所有隐藏状态聚合信息。 鉴于我们 DiT 的规模，走那条路似乎有些大材小用了。

sents.zh: 最近的 Ideogram 和 FLUX 模型在这方面更为激进，使用更大的大语言模型并跨所有隐藏状态聚合信息。

sents.en: Given the size of our DiT, it seemed like overkill to go down that path.
sents.zh: 鉴于我们 DiT 的规模，走那条路似乎有些大材小用了。

paragraphs.en: text conditioning · three hidden states, one learned projection
paragraphs.zh: 文本条件化 · 三个隐藏状态，一个可学习的投影

paragraphs.en: At train time, we get to pick the distribution from which t is sampled. Empirically, there's a small band of values at high t where the structure of the image is determined. This is the hardest part of the trajectory for the model to learn, so we skew timesteps accordingly.
paragraphs.zh: 在训练时，我们可以选择 t 的采样分布。 从经验上看，在高 t 处存在一小段取值区间，图像的结构正是在那里被确定的。 这是轨迹中模型最难学习的部分，因此我们相应地对时间步进行了偏置。

sents.en: At train time, we get to pick the distribution from which t is sampled.
sents.zh: 在训练时，我们可以选择 t 的采样分布。

sents.zh: 从经验上看，在高 t 处存在一小段取值区间，图像的结构正是在那里被确定的。

paragraphs.en: Note that the σ term is tied to pixel count: σ = 1 is for 256×256, σ = 2 is for 512×512. The intuition is that we need to shift more aggressively at higher pixel counts. There is more redundant information within the image, so we need to noise more. This is the exact schedule from JiT.
paragraphs.zh: 注意 σ 项与像素数量相关：σ = 1 对应 256×256，σ = 2 对应 512×512。 直觉上，在更高的像素数量下我们需要更激进地进行偏移。 图像内部存在更多冗余信息，因此我们需要加入更多噪声。 这正是来自 JiT 的调度方案。

sents.zh: 注意 σ 项与像素数量相关：σ = 1 对应 256×256，σ = 2 对应 512×512。

paragraphs.en: The MSE is x-prediction with the velocity weighting (x-prediction, v-loss), clamped at t = 0.1 so the weight caps out at 100×. LPIPS and P-DINO are perceptual losses on the predicted image. PixelREPA aligns the block-8 hidden state with DINOv3 features of the clean image (downsampled 2× to match the token grid of h₈).
paragraphs.zh: MSE 采用速度加权的 x 预测（x-prediction，v-loss），并在 t = 0.1 处截断，使权重上限为 100 倍。 LPIPS 和 P-DINO 是作用于预测图像的感知损失。 PixelREPA 将第 8 个块的隐状态与干净图像的 DINOv3 特征对齐（下采样 2 倍以匹配 h₈ 的 token 网格）。

sents.en: The MSE is x-prediction with the velocity weighting (x-prediction, v-loss), clamped at t = 0.1 so the weight caps out at 100×.
sents.zh: MSE 采用速度加权的 x 预测（x-prediction，v-loss），并在 t = 0.1 处截断，使权重上限为 100 倍。

paragraphs.en: One of the biggest limitations that folks have observed about JiTs is that they struggle to generate the finegrained details. Our baselines corroborate this. If we want to really get our pixel space models to sing, we need to fix this.
paragraphs.zh: 人们观察到的 JiTs 最大的局限之一是它们难以生成细粒度的细节。 我们的基线证实了这一点。 如果我们想让像素空间模型真正大放异彩，就需要解决这个问题。

sents.en: One of the biggest limitations that folks have observed about JiTs is that they struggle to generate the finegrained details.
sents.zh: 人们观察到的 JiTs 最大的局限之一是它们难以生成细粒度的细节。

sents.en: Our baselines corroborate this.
sents.zh: 我们的基线证实了这一点。

sents.en: If we want to really get our pixel space models to sing, we need to fix this.
sents.zh: 如果我们想让像素空间模型真正大放异彩，就需要解决这个问题。

paragraphs.en: In early 2025, Shuai Wang and team tackled this problem directly with their DDT (Decoupled Diffusion Transformer), scoring SOTA on ImageNet gFID at the time. They observed that —
paragraphs.zh: 2025年初，王帅及其团队用他们的DDT（解耦扩散Transformer，Decoupled Diffusion Transformer）直接解决了这个问题，在当时取得了ImageNet gFID的SOTA成绩。他们观察到——

paragraphs.en: In each denoising step, diffusion transformers encode the noisy inputs to extract the lower-frequency semantic component and then decode the higher frequency with identical modules. This scheme creates an inherent optimization dilemma: encoding low-frequency semantics necessitates reducing high-frequency components, creating tension between semantic encoding and high-frequency decoding.
paragraphs.zh: 在每个去噪步骤中，扩散变换器先对带噪输入进行编码以提取低频语义成分，然后再用相同的模块解码高频成分。 这种方案带来了固有的优化困境：编码低频语义必然要求削弱高频成分，从而使语义编码与高频解码之间产生矛盾。

sents.zh: 在每个去噪步骤中，扩散变换器先对带噪输入进行编码以提取低频语义成分，然后再用相同的模块解码高频成分。

sents.en: This scheme creates an inherent optimization dilemma: encoding low-frequency semantics necessitates reducing high-frequency components, creating tension between semantic encoding and high-frequency decoding.
sents.zh: 这种方案带来了固有的优化困境：编码低频语义必然要求削弱高频成分，从而使语义编码与高频解码之间产生矛盾。

paragraphs.en: DDT splits the model into two components, a "conditional encoder" for low-frequency structure and a "velocity decoder" for high-frequency detail. They give the encoder most of the layers, since the most difficult portion of the probability path to master is the transition from random noise to basic structure. When you train a diffusion model, you have to sample timesteps between and to turn your clean samples into noise-interpolated . Since Stable Diffusion 3 , it's been widely known that there seems to be a small band of high- values where the overall structure of the image is determined. We oversample from this part of the distribution, to accelerate convergence. This finding was the inspiration for the DDT to allocate the bulk of its parameters to the encoder.
paragraphs.zh: DDT 将模型拆分为两个组件：一个用于低频结构的「条件编码器」和一个用于高频细节的「速度解码器」。 他们将大部分层分配给了编码器，因为概率路径中最难掌握的部分是从随机噪声到基本结构的过渡。 在训练扩散模型时，你需要在时间和之间采样时间步，以便将干净样本转化为噪声插值样本。 自 Stable Diffusion 3 以来，人们普遍知道似乎存在一个较小的取值区间，在那里图像的整体结构被确定。 我们从该分布的这一部分进行过采样，以加速收敛。 这一发现正是 DDT 将其大部分参数分配给编码器的灵感来源。

paragraphs.en: Within the encoder they apply REPresentation Alignment (REPA) , an auxiliary loss that accelerates training by aligning the hidden states of an early layer of the model to the DINO representation of the clean image ( ). If you keep REPA loss active throughout all of training in standard DiTs, it actually hurts overall FID .
paragraphs.zh: 在编码器中，他们应用了表征对齐（REPA），这是一种辅助损失，通过将模型早期层的隐藏状态与干净图像的 DINO 表征对齐来加速训练（ ）。 如果在标准 DiT 的整个训练过程中始终保持 REPA 损失处于激活状态，实际上会损害整体 FID。

paragraphs.en: The DDT avoids this problem by giving the decoder the noised image ( ) so it can extract the finegrained details that REPA might otherwise destroy. Moreover, the DDT frees up the decoder to focus solely on details by creating an information bottleneck. The decoder doesn't get the class label. Given its limited capacity, it's forced to rely on the encoder's hidden states to ascertain structure. And in turn, it allocates its parameters to focus on detail recovery.
paragraphs.zh: DDT 通过将带噪图像（ ）提供给解码器来避免这个问题，从而能够提取出 REPA 可能会破坏的细粒度细节。 此外，DDT 通过创建信息瓶颈，让解码器得以专注于细节本身。 解码器不会获得类别标签。 由于其容量有限，它被迫依赖编码器的隐藏状态来确定结构。 反过来，它将其参数分配用于专注于细节恢复。

paragraphs.en: Naturally, we tried to port over the core ideas from the DDT so that we could recover detail in our pixel space model. We call this new architecture JiT-DDT (creative, we know).
paragraphs.zh: 自然地，我们尝试将 DDT 的核心思想移植过来，以便在像素空间模型中恢复细节。 我们将这一新架构称为 JiT-DDT（我们知道，这名字很有创意）。

sents.en: Naturally, we tried to port over the core ideas from the DDT so that we could recover detail in our pixel space model.
sents.zh: 自然地，我们尝试将 DDT 的核心思想移植过来，以便在像素空间模型中恢复细节。

sents.en: We call this new architecture JiT-DDT (creative, we know).
sents.zh: 我们将这一新架构称为 JiT-DDT（我们知道，这名字很有创意）。

paragraphs.en: Ours is trained with x-prediction, v-loss, unlike the DDT which was trained with the classic v-prediction, v-loss formulation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的模型采用 x-预测、v-损失进行训练，而 DDT 采用的是经典的 v-预测、v-损失公式进行训练。

paragraphs.en: This is crucial. If you downsample an image, you strip it of most of its high frequency detail, leaving behind low-frequency structure. So in an x-prediction-world, we can get our encoder to learn structure explicitly by predicting a low-resolution version of our input image, .
paragraphs.zh: 这一点至关重要。 如果你对图像进行下采样，就会去除它大部分高频细节，只留下低频结构。 因此，在x预测的世界里，我们可以让编码器通过预测输入图像的低分辨率版本来显式地学习结构，。

sents.zh: 这一点至关重要。

sents.zh: 如果你对图像进行下采样，就会去除它大部分高频细节，只留下低频结构。

sents.en: So in an x-prediction-world, we can get our encoder to learn structure explicitly by predicting a low-resolution version of our input image, .
sents.zh: 因此，在x预测的世界里，我们可以让编码器通过预测输入图像的低分辨率版本来显式地学习结构，。

paragraphs.en: Concretely, we split our DiT in half. We give the encoder and decoder their own input patchification and output heads, so they can specialize. We have the encoder predict a 64×64 version of the input 512×512 image (8× downsampled) and pass its hidden states to the decoder. This way the decoder gets a structural sketch of the output, its own view of the noised image, and the text prompt to create the full resolution image.
paragraphs.zh: 具体来说，我们将 DiT 从中间拆分为两半。 我们让编码器和解码器各自拥有独立的输入分块化与输出头，以便它们能够各自特化。 我们让编码器预测输入 512×512 图像的 64×64 版本（8 倍下采样），并将其隐藏状态传递给解码器。 这样，解码器就能获得输出的结构草图、对加噪图像的自身视角以及文本提示，从而生成完整分辨率的图像。

sents.en: Concretely, we split our DiT in half.
sents.zh: 具体来说，我们将 DiT 从中间拆分为两半。

sents.en: We give the encoder and decoder their own input patchification and output heads, so they can specialize.
sents.zh: 我们让编码器和解码器各自拥有独立的输入分块化与输出头，以便它们能够各自特化。

sents.en: We have the encoder predict a 64×64 version of the input 512×512 image (8× downsampled) and pass its hidden states to the decoder.
sents.zh: 我们让编码器预测输入 512×512 图像的 64×64 版本（8 倍下采样），并将其隐藏状态传递给解码器。

sents.en: This way the decoder gets a structural sketch of the output, its own view of the noised image, and the text prompt to create the full resolution image.
sents.zh: 这样，解码器就能获得输出的结构草图、对加噪图像的自身视角以及文本提示，从而生成完整分辨率的图像。

paragraphs.en: JiT-DDT: the encoder plans a 64×64 image; the decoder uses that plan, full-resolution x_t and text to generate the 512×512 image
paragraphs.zh: JiT-DDT：编码器规划一张 64×64 的图像；解码器利用该规划、全分辨率的 x_t 和文本，生成 512×512 的图像

paragraphs.en: One added benefit of this design is that we can have asymmetric patch sizes between the encoder and the decoder. If we're training on 512×512 images, the encoder will be tasked with regressing the 64×64 version of the image. It needs less information to do this task, so we can use 64×64 patches and operate on a 64-token sequence. Meanwhile, the decoder can use smaller patches to help recover detail (e.g. 32×32 patches or even 16×16 patches).
paragraphs.zh: 这种设计的一个额外好处是，编码器和解码器之间可以使用不对称的patch大小。 如果我们在512×512的图像上训练，编码器的任务是对图像的64×64版本进行回归。 完成这个任务所需的信息更少，因此我们可以使用64×64的patch，并在一个64个token的序列上进行操作。 同时，解码器可以使用更小的patch来帮助恢复细节（例如32×32的patch，甚至16×16的patch）。

sents.en: One added benefit of this design is that we can have asymmetric patch sizes between the encoder and the decoder.
sents.zh: 这种设计的一个额外好处是，编码器和解码器之间可以使用不对称的patch大小。

sents.en: If we're training on 512×512 images, the encoder will be tasked with regressing the 64×64 version of the image.
sents.zh: 如果我们在512×512的图像上训练，编码器的任务是对图像的64×64版本进行回归。

sents.en: It needs less information to do this task, so we can use 64×64 patches and operate on a 64-token sequence.
sents.zh: 完成这个任务所需的信息更少，因此我们可以使用64×64的patch，并在一个64个token的序列上进行操作。

paragraphs.en: We make two additional deviations from the original DDT's architecture:
paragraphs.zh: 我们对原始 DDT 的架构做了另外两处改动：

paragraphs.en: The JiT-DDT loss: the encoder is scored on the 64×64 plan, the decoder on the 512×512 image
paragraphs.zh: JiT-DDT 损失：编码器在 64×64 平面上评分，解码器在 512×512 图像上评分

paragraphs.en: We compute the MSE loss twice, once for the encoder against an 8× downsampled version of x₀ and once for the decoder against the original x₀. We keep the alignment loss in the encoder, moving it earlier in the network (tapped after block 6 of 12, against DINOv3 features of x₀ downsampled 4× to match the token grid of the encoder's h₆). And, we keep the perceptual losses on the full resolution outputs of the decoder. The gradient runs end to end, so the decoder's loss trains the encoder too.
paragraphs.zh: 我们计算两次 MSE 损失，一次针对编码器，使用 x₀ 的 8× 下采样版本；一次针对解码器，使用原始的 x₀。 我们保留编码器中的对齐损失，并将其移到网络中更靠前的位置（在 12 个块中的第 6 块之后引出，针对 x₀ 下采样 4× 后的 DINOv3 特征，以匹配编码器 h₆ 的 token 网格）。 此外，我们保留解码器全分辨率输出上的感知损失。 梯度是端到端传播的，因此解码器的损失也会训练编码器。

sents.en: We keep the alignment loss in the encoder, moving it earlier in the network (tapped after block 6 of 12, against DINOv3 features of x₀ downsampled 4× to match the token grid of the encoder's h₆).

sents.en: And, we keep the perceptual losses on the full resolution outputs of the decoder.
sents.zh: 此外，我们保留解码器全分辨率输出上的感知损失。

sents.en: The gradient runs end to end, so the decoder's loss trains the encoder too.
sents.zh: 梯度是端到端传播的，因此解码器的损失也会训练编码器。

Both help the model massage the modalities before combining them in a shared DiT trunk. The other knobs (AdaLN truncation, post-norm gate + tanh, RMSNorm) didn't move the needle for us, so we omit them from our experiments.

paragraphs.zh: JiT-DDT 64/32 + 噪声偏移 + 精炼器（refiners）

paragraphs.en: The encoder and the decoder each get four modality-specific blocks before the shared DiT trunk: two for image, two for text (8 new blocks in total, 477M additional parameters).
paragraphs.zh: 编码器和解码器在共享的 DiT 主干之前各有四个模态专用块：两个用于图像，两个用于文本（共新增 8 个块，额外增加 4.77 亿参数）。

paragraphs.en: We trimmed one shared block from each stack (2 total) which brought the refiner model within ~5% of the no-refiner model's FLOPs. The modality-specific blocks are much cheaper to run, since they see about half the sequence length of the shared blocks.

paragraphs.en: Our goal is to reduce tokens in the DiT context window. That way we can accelerate training and inference. Traditionally, DiTs have struggled to learn from high-dimensional inputs because of the curse of dimensionality implicit to v-prediction.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的目标是减少 DiT 上下文窗口中的 token。 这样我们就可以加速训练和推理。 传统上，由于 v-prediction 固有的维数灾难，DiT 一直难以从高维输入中学习。

sents.en: Our goal is to reduce tokens in the DiT context window.
sents.zh: 我们的目标是减少 DiT 上下文窗口中的 token。

sents.en: That way we can accelerate training and inference.
sents.zh: 这样我们就可以加速训练和推理。

sents.en: Traditionally, DiTs have struggled to learn from high-dimensional inputs because of the curse of dimensionality implicit to v-prediction.
sents.zh: 传统上，由于 v-prediction 固有的维数灾难，DiT 一直难以从高维输入中学习。

paragraphs.en: If we swap in x-prediction, we can get DiTs to successfully learn from high dimensional samples. We can use this fact to apply linear patchification, throw away the VAE, and push the compression problem into the DiT. This way we can develop the latent space specifically for generation and at the same time get the token savings we're looking for.
paragraphs.zh: 如果我们换用 x 预测，就能让 DiT 成功地从高维样本中学习。 我们可以利用这一事实来应用线性分块，去掉 VAE，并把压缩问题转移给 DiT。 这样我们就可以专门为生成来构建潜空间，同时获得我们想要的 token 节省。

sents.en: If we swap in x-prediction, we can get DiTs to successfully learn from high dimensional samples.
sents.zh: 如果我们换用 x 预测，就能让 DiT 成功地从高维样本中学习。

sents.en: We can use this fact to apply linear patchification, throw away the VAE, and push the compression problem into the DiT.
sents.zh: 我们可以利用这一事实来应用线性分块，去掉 VAE，并把压缩问题转移给 DiT。

sents.en: This way we can develop the latent space specifically for generation and at the same time get the token savings we're looking for.
sents.zh: 这样我们就可以专门为生成来构建潜空间，同时获得我们想要的 token 节省。

paragraphs.en: The one downside to this approach is that the JiT struggles to learn finegrained details out of the box. Humans perceive these details quite easily, so we need these if we want to generate good images and videos. Our JiT-DDT is one way we can get pixel-space models to learn structure and detail.
paragraphs.zh: 这种方法的一个缺点是，即插即用训练（JiT）开箱即用时难以学习细粒度的细节。 人类很容易感知这些细节，所以如果我们想生成好的图像和视频，就需要这些细节。 我们的 JiT-DDT 是让像素空间模型学习结构与细节的一种方式。

sents.en: The one downside to this approach is that the JiT struggles to learn finegrained details out of the box.
sents.zh: 这种方法的一个缺点是，即插即用训练（JiT）开箱即用时难以学习细粒度的细节。

sents.en: Humans perceive these details quite easily, so we need these if we want to generate good images and videos.

sents.en: Our JiT-DDT is one way we can get pixel-space models to learn structure and detail.
sents.zh: 我们的 JiT-DDT 是让像素空间模型学习结构与细节的一种方式。

paragraphs.en: JiT-DDT trains in 3.6× fewer GPU-hours at 4× pixels
paragraphs.zh: JiT-DDT 在 4 倍像素下以少 3.6 倍的 GPU 小时进行训练

paragraphs.en: We think that it's useful to look at the JiT-DDT in the context of three papers ( iREPA , Self-Flow , RAE v2 ), to try to unpack why our architecture works in the first place.
paragraphs.zh: 我们认为，结合三篇论文（iREPA、Self-Flow、RAE v2）来看 JiT-DDT 是有用的，这有助于我们首先弄清楚为什么我们的架构能够奏效。

paragraphs.en: As we mentioned earlier, REPA has become a standard way to accelerate DiT convergence. The original authors tried a few different vision encoders and found that DINOv2 worked the best. But, it wasn't until iREPA late last year that anyone took a serious look into why DINO seems to work so well.
paragraphs.zh: 正如我们之前提到的，REPA 已成为加速 DiT 收敛的标准方法。 原作者尝试了几种不同的视觉编码器，发现 DINOv2 效果最好。 但直到去年年底 iREPA 出现之前，还没有人认真研究过 DINO 为什么效果如此之好。

sents.en: As we mentioned earlier, REPA has become a standard way to accelerate DiT convergence.
sents.zh: 正如我们之前提到的，REPA 已成为加速 DiT 收敛的标准方法。

sents.en: The original authors tried a few different vision encoders and found that DINOv2 worked the best.
sents.zh: 原作者尝试了几种不同的视觉编码器，发现 DINOv2 效果最好。

sents.en: But, it wasn't until iREPA late last year that anyone took a serious look into why DINO seems to work so well.
sents.zh: 但直到去年年底 iREPA 出现之前，还没有人认真研究过 DINO 为什么效果如此之好。

paragraphs.en: iREPA trained a bunch of generative image models on ImageNet with REPA, using a larger test bed of vision encoders. DINOv3, modern JEPA variants and Masked Autoencoders. They looked at the models' gFID scores and tried to determine whether generation quality could be attributed to either the vision encoder's understanding of the holistic image or its understanding of spatial structure.
paragraphs.zh: iREPA 在 ImageNet 上使用 REPA 训练了一批生成式图像模型，并采用了更大规模的视觉编码器测试平台。 包括 DINOv3、现代的 JEPA 变体以及掩码自编码器。 他们查看了这些模型的 gFID 分数，试图确定生成质量究竟可以归因于视觉编码器对图像整体的理解，还是对其空间结构的理解。

sents.en: iREPA trained a bunch of generative image models on ImageNet with REPA, using a larger test bed of vision encoders.
sents.zh: iREPA 在 ImageNet 上使用 REPA 训练了一批生成式图像模型，并采用了更大规模的视觉编码器测试平台。

sents.en: DINOv3, modern JEPA variants and Masked Autoencoders.
sents.zh: 包括 DINOv3、现代的 JEPA 变体以及掩码自编码器。

sents.en: They looked at the models' gFID scores and tried to determine whether generation quality could be attributed to either the vision encoder's understanding of the holistic image or its understanding of spatial structure.
sents.zh: 他们查看了这些模型的 gFID 分数，试图确定生成质量究竟可以归因于视觉编码器对图像整体的理解，还是对其空间结构的理解。

paragraphs.en: For holistic understanding, they relied on linear ImageNet probes. For spatial structure, they constructed a suite of self-similarity metrics. These quantify how much more correlated patches from an object are to each other than patches from other objects in the same image (e.g. patches of a lion's mane should be more correlated with other parts of the lion's mane than patches of the background skyline).
paragraphs.zh: 为了进行全面的理解，他们依赖于线性 ImageNet 探针。 为了分析空间结构，他们构建了一套自相似性度量指标。 这些指标用于量化同一图像中来自同一物体的图像块之间的相关性比来自其他物体的图像块高多少（例如，狮鬃的图像块应当与狮鬃其他部分的相关性高于与背景天际线图像块的相关性）。

sents.en: For holistic understanding, they relied on linear ImageNet probes.
sents.zh: 为了进行全面的理解，他们依赖于线性 ImageNet 探针。

sents.en: For spatial structure, they constructed a suite of self-similarity metrics.
sents.zh: 为了分析空间结构，他们构建了一套自相似性度量指标。

sents.en: These quantify how much more correlated patches from an object are to each other than patches from other objects in the same image (e.g. patches of a lion's mane should be more correlated with other parts of the lion's mane than patches of the background skyline).
sents.zh: 这些指标用于量化同一图像中来自同一物体的图像块之间的相关性比来自其他物体的图像块高多少（例如，狮鬃的图像块应当与狮鬃其他部分的相关性高于与背景天际线图像块的相关性）。

paragraphs.en: They found that higher ImageNet probe accuracy predicted worse gFID, while higher spatial self-similarity predicted much better gFID. Accordingly, it seems like REPA accelerates training by getting early layers of the network to see local structure, not holistic visual concepts.
paragraphs.zh: 他们发现，更高的 ImageNet 探测准确率预测出更差的 gFID，而更高的空间自相似性则预测出好得多的 gFID。 因此，REPA 似乎是通过让网络的早期层看到局部结构而非整体视觉概念来加速训练的。

sents.en: They found that higher ImageNet probe accuracy predicted worse gFID, while higher spatial self-similarity predicted much better gFID.
sents.zh: 他们发现，更高的 ImageNet 探测准确率预测出更差的 gFID，而更高的空间自相似性则预测出好得多的 gFID。

sents.en: Accordingly, it seems like REPA accelerates training by getting early layers of the network to see local structure, not holistic visual concepts.
sents.zh: 因此，REPA 似乎是通过让网络的早期层看到局部结构而非整体视觉概念来加速训练的。

paragraphs.en: Higher ImageNet accuracy, worse gFID; higher self-similarity, better gFID
paragraphs.zh: 更高的 ImageNet 准确率，更差的 gFID；更高的自相似性，更好的 gFID

paragraphs.en: Here, we have two distinct vision encoders, WebSSL-1B and SpatialPE-B. WebSSL-1B scores higher on the ImageNet probe (76.0% vs. 53.1%) but lower on spatial self-similarity (0.18 vs. 0.34).
paragraphs.zh: 这里，我们有两个不同的视觉编码器：WebSSL-1B 和 SpatialPE-B。 WebSSL-1B 在 ImageNet 探测任务上得分更高（76.0% 对 53.1%），但在空间自相似性上得分更低（0.18 对 0.34）。

sents.en: Here, we have two distinct vision encoders, WebSSL-1B and SpatialPE-B.
sents.zh: 这里，我们有两个不同的视觉编码器：WebSSL-1B 和 SpatialPE-B。

sents.en: WebSSL-1B scores higher on the ImageNet probe (76.0% vs. 53.1%) but lower on spatial self-similarity (0.18 vs. 0.34).
sents.zh: WebSSL-1B 在 ImageNet 探测任务上得分更高（76.0% 对 53.1%），但在空间自相似性上得分更低（0.18 对 0.34）。

paragraphs.en: Pay attention to the red box in the middle column, highlighting the dead grass. Yellow is most correlated, green is somewhat correlated, and blue is least correlated. In WebSSL-1B, the grass is correlated with everything but the lion (e.g. correlated with the sky). Meanwhile in SpatialPE-B, it's only correlated with the other blades of grass.
paragraphs.zh: 注意中间列的红色方框，它高亮标出了枯草。 黄色表示相关性最强，绿色表示有一定相关性，蓝色表示相关性最弱。 在 WebSSL-1B 中，草与除狮子之外的所有内容都相关（例如与天空相关）。 而在 SpatialPE-B 中，草只与其他草叶相关。

sents.zh: 注意中间列的红色方框，它高亮标出了枯草。

sents.en: Yellow is most correlated, green is somewhat correlated, and blue is least correlated.
sents.zh: 黄色表示相关性最强，绿色表示有一定相关性，蓝色表示相关性最弱。

sents.en: In WebSSL-1B, the grass is correlated with everything but the lion (e.g. correlated with the sky).
sents.zh: 在 WebSSL-1B 中，草与除狮子之外的所有内容都相关（例如与天空相关）。

sents.en: Meanwhile in SpatialPE-B, it's only correlated with the other blades of grass.
sents.zh: 而在 SpatialPE-B 中，草只与其他草叶相关。

paragraphs.en: The iREPA authors find that DiT aligned to WebSSL-1B generates worse images than those aligned to SpatialPE-B (gFID 26.1 vs. 21.0). Figure from iREPA (2025).
paragraphs.zh: iREPA 的作者发现，与 WebSSL-1B 对齐的 DiT 生成的图像质量劣于与 SpatialPE-B 对齐的 DiT（gFID 26.1 对 21.0）。 图像来自 iREPA（2025）。

sents.en: The iREPA authors find that DiT aligned to WebSSL-1B generates worse images than those aligned to SpatialPE-B (gFID 26.1 vs. 21.0).
sents.zh: iREPA 的作者发现，与 WebSSL-1B 对齐的 DiT 生成的图像质量劣于与 SpatialPE-B 对齐的 DiT（gFID 26.1 对 21.0）。

sents.en: Figure from iREPA (2025).
sents.zh: 图像来自 iREPA（2025）。

paragraphs.en: We think that this finding rhymes with the encoder-prediction task in our JiT-DDT. Downsampling images (e.g. 512×512 to 64×64) strips images of all detail, leaving us only with structure. By predicting the low-resolution image early in the JiT-DDT, we are providing a similar signal.
paragraphs.zh: 我们认为这一发现与我们 JiT-DDT 中的编码器预测任务相呼应。 对图像进行下采样（例如从 512×512 到 64×64）会剥除图像的所有细节，只留下结构。 通过让 JiT-DDT 在早期预测低分辨率图像，我们提供了类似的信号。

sents.en: We think that this finding rhymes with the encoder-prediction task in our JiT-DDT.
sents.zh: 我们认为这一发现与我们 JiT-DDT 中的编码器预测任务相呼应。

sents.en: Downsampling images (e.g. 512×512 to 64×64) strips images of all detail, leaving us only with structure.
sents.zh: 对图像进行下采样（例如从 512×512 到 64×64）会剥除图像的所有细节，只留下结构。

sents.en: By predicting the low-resolution image early in the JiT-DDT, we are providing a similar signal.
sents.zh: 通过让 JiT-DDT 在早期预测低分辨率图像，我们提供了类似的信号。

paragraphs.en: Taking a step back, it feels really weird that we're aligning a multibillion parameter DiT to the hidden space of a ~100M unsupervised vision encoder. Bigger models should have more capacity, so it's sus that we're relying so much on the representation space of a tiny model.
paragraphs.zh: 退一步来看，我们把一个数十亿参数的 DiT 对齐到一个约 1 亿参数的无监督视觉编码器的隐空间，这件事感觉真的很奇怪。 更大的模型本应有更强的容量，所以我们如此依赖一个小模型的表示空间，这很可疑。

sents.en: Taking a step back, it feels really weird that we're aligning a multibillion parameter DiT to the hidden space of a ~100M unsupervised vision encoder.
sents.zh: 退一步来看，我们把一个数十亿参数的 DiT 对齐到一个约 1 亿参数的无监督视觉编码器的隐空间，这件事感觉真的很奇怪。

sents.en: Bigger models should have more capacity, so it's sus that we're relying so much on the representation space of a tiny model.
sents.zh: 更大的模型本应有更强的容量，所以我们如此依赖一个小模型的表示空间，这很可疑。

paragraphs.en: Black Forest Labs (the authors of Stable Diffusion and FLUX) seem to agree with our premise. In Self-Flow , they throw away DINO and achieve better FID results by aligning to the hidden states later in the network.
paragraphs.zh: Black Forest Labs（Stable Diffusion 和 FLUX 的作者）似乎认同我们的前提。 在 Self-Flow 中，他们舍弃了 DINO，通过向网络后段的隐藏状态对齐，取得了更好的 FID 结果。

sents.en: Black Forest Labs (the authors of Stable Diffusion and FLUX) seem to agree with our premise.
sents.zh: Black Forest Labs（Stable Diffusion 和 FLUX 的作者）似乎认同我们的前提。

sents.en: In Self-Flow , they throw away DINO and achieve better FID results by aligning to the hidden states later in the network.
sents.zh: 在 Self-Flow 中，他们舍弃了 DINO，通过向网络后段的隐藏状态对齐，取得了更好的 FID 结果。

paragraphs.en: Another paper from last year found that the later layers of the DiT learn structure quite quickly, while early layers lag significantly. If the deeper layers already learn this structure without external intervention, we can simply align to them. This way you accelerate learning, without the representational ceiling imposed by traditional REPA.
paragraphs.zh: 去年的另一篇论文发现，DiT 的后面几层学结构学得相当快，而前面几层明显滞后。 如果更深的层无需外部干预就已经学到了这种结构，我们可以直接向它们对齐。 这样你就能加速学习，同时不受传统 REPA 所带来的表征上限的限制。

sents.en: Another paper from last year found that the later layers of the DiT learn structure quite quickly, while early layers lag significantly.
sents.zh: 去年的另一篇论文发现，DiT 的后面几层学结构学得相当快，而前面几层明显滞后。

sents.en: If the deeper layers already learn this structure without external intervention, we can simply align to them.
sents.zh: 如果更深的层无需外部干预就已经学到了这种结构，我们可以直接向它们对齐。

sents.en: This way you accelerate learning, without the representational ceiling imposed by traditional REPA.
sents.zh: 这样你就能加速学习，同时不受传统 REPA 所带来的表征上限的限制。

paragraphs.en: We see Self-Flow and our JiT-DDT as cousins of sorts, tackling 3 core problems with different solutions:
paragraphs.zh: 我们认为 Self-Flow 和我们的 JiT-DDT 算是“近亲”，它们用不同的解决方案解决 3 个核心问题：

paragraphs.en: Early on, we tried JiT + Self-Flow and it performed worse than JiT + PixelREPA .
paragraphs.zh: 早期，我们尝试了 JiT + Self-Flow，其表现比 JiT + PixelREPA 更差。

paragraphs.en: Our gut is that this discrepancy just comes down to the amount of samples seen during the training. We use 100-150M samples per experiment. We can't tell from BFL's primary figure how many images they used in ImageNet training.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的直觉是，这种差异只是源于训练期间所见样本的数量。 我们在每个实验中使用1亿至1.5亿个样本。 我们无法从BFL的主图中看出他们在ImageNet训练中使用了多少图像。

sents.en: Our gut is that this discrepancy just comes down to the amount of samples seen during the training.
sents.zh: 我们的直觉是，这种差异只是源于训练期间所见样本的数量。

sents.en: We use 100-150M samples per experiment.
sents.zh: 我们在每个实验中使用1亿至1.5亿个样本。

sents.en: We can't tell from BFL's primary figure how many images they used in ImageNet training.
sents.zh: 我们无法从BFL的主图中看出他们在ImageNet训练中使用了多少图像。

paragraphs.en: When we dropped PixelREPA from our JiT-DDT, the images were 5-10% worse. So, it looks like distillation from the auxiliary vision model remains helpful in low sample regimes.
paragraphs.zh: 当我们从 JiT-DDT 中去掉 PixelREPA 后，图像效果变差了 5-10%。 因此，在低样本场景下，从辅助视觉模型进行蒸馏似乎仍然是有帮助的。

sents.en: When we dropped PixelREPA from our JiT-DDT, the images were 5-10% worse.
sents.zh: 当我们从 JiT-DDT 中去掉 PixelREPA 后，图像效果变差了 5-10%。

sents.en: So, it looks like distillation from the auxiliary vision model remains helpful in low sample regimes.
sents.zh: 因此，在低样本场景下，从辅助视觉模型进行蒸馏似乎仍然是有帮助的。

paragraphs.en: Since we view JiT-DDT as a cousin of Self-Flow, we'd like to eventually train our architecture on 10x more samples with/without PixelREPA and see if we can get better generations without the auxiliary vision encoder.
paragraphs.zh: 由于我们将 JiT-DDT 视为 Self-Flow 的近亲，我们希望最终能在多 10 倍的样本上（使用/不使用 PixelREPA）训练我们的架构，看看能否在没有辅助视觉编码器的情况下获得更好的生成结果。

paragraphs.en: One more thing to call out is that there is a clear discrepancy in the effect the REPA has in pixel space versus VAE latent space. Plain REPA actively hurt our JiT. That's why we switched to PixelREPA in the first place. We ablated whether to keep PixelREPA on for the entirety of training or switch it off midway (as is conventional wisdom). The results were a wash; PixelREPA's masking op might be a regularizer helping us avoid overfitting to DINO space.
paragraphs.zh: 还有一点需要指出的是，REPA 在像素空间与 VAE 潜空间中的作用存在明显差异。 原始的 REPA 实际上损害了我们的 JiT。 这正是我们最初改用 PixelREPA 的原因。 我们消融实验比较了是在整个训练过程中一直保持 PixelREPA 开启，还是在训练中途将其关闭（这是常规做法）。 结果不相上下；PixelREPA 的掩码操作可能起到了正则化的作用，帮助我们避免过拟合于 DINO 空间。

sents.en: One more thing to call out is that there is a clear discrepancy in the effect the REPA has in pixel space versus VAE latent space.
sents.zh: 还有一点需要指出的是，REPA 在像素空间与 VAE 潜空间中的作用存在明显差异。

sents.en: Plain REPA actively hurt our JiT.
sents.zh: 原始的 REPA 实际上损害了我们的 JiT。

sents.en: That's why we switched to PixelREPA in the first place.
sents.zh: 这正是我们最初改用 PixelREPA 的原因。

sents.en: We ablated whether to keep PixelREPA on for the entirety of training or switch it off midway (as is conventional wisdom).
sents.zh: 我们消融实验比较了是在整个训练过程中一直保持 PixelREPA 开启，还是在训练中途将其关闭（这是常规做法）。

sents.en: The results were a wash; PixelREPA's masking op might be a regularizer helping us avoid overfitting to DINO space.
sents.zh: 结果不相上下；PixelREPA 的掩码操作可能起到了正则化的作用，帮助我们避免过拟合于 DINO 空间。

paragraphs.en: While Self-Flow finds a path forward without DINO alignment, others have gone the other way. In RAE v2 , the authors achieve SOTA on ImageNet FID by training a DiT in DINO space.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然 Self-Flow 在没有 DINO 对齐的情况下也找到了一条前进的路径，但其他工作则走向了相反的方向。 在 RAE v2 中，作者通过在 DINO 空间中训练一个 DiT，在 ImageNet FID 上达到了最先进（SOTA）水平。

sents.en: While Self-Flow finds a path forward without DINO alignment, others have gone the other way.
sents.zh: 虽然 Self-Flow 在没有 DINO 对齐的情况下也找到了一条前进的路径，但其他工作则走向了相反的方向。

sents.en: In RAE v2 , the authors achieve SOTA on ImageNet FID by training a DiT in DINO space.
sents.zh: 在 RAE v2 中，作者通过在 DINO 空间中训练一个 DiT，在 ImageNet FID 上达到了最先进（SOTA）水平。

paragraphs.en: Instead of using patches like our pixel space models or VAEs like BFL, they run DINOv3 on all of their images, summing together the hidden states across many layers of DINO to come up with a representation. They then train two independent models, the flow matching generative model and a decoder from DINO space back to pixel space.
paragraphs.zh: 他们的做法不是像我们的像素空间模型那样使用图块，也不像 BFL 那样使用 VAE，而是对所有图像运行 DINOv3，将 DINO 多个层的隐藏状态相加，得到一个表示。 然后他们训练两个相互独立的模型：一个流匹配生成模型，以及一个从 DINO 空间解码回像素空间的解码器。

sents.en: Instead of using patches like our pixel space models or VAEs like BFL, they run DINOv3 on all of their images, summing together the hidden states across many layers of DINO to come up with a representation.
sents.zh: 他们的做法不是像我们的像素空间模型那样使用图块，也不像 BFL 那样使用 VAE，而是对所有图像运行 DINOv3，将 DINO 多个层的隐藏状态相加，得到一个表示。

sents.en: They then train two independent models, the flow matching generative model and a decoder from DINO space back to pixel space.
sents.zh: 然后他们训练两个相互独立的模型：一个流匹配生成模型，以及一个从 DINO 空间解码回像素空间的解码器。

paragraphs.en: If you're training in DINO space already, it'd be logical to axe out REPA. But turns out, it still unlocks better generations in RAE v2. Let's pause for a second. That's really weird.
paragraphs.zh: 如果你已经在 DINO 空间中训练，那么去掉 REPA 才是合乎逻辑的做法。 但事实证明，它在 RAE v2 中仍能带来更好的生成效果。 让我们先停一下。这真的很奇怪。

sents.en: If you're training in DINO space already, it'd be logical to axe out REPA.
sents.zh: 如果你已经在 DINO 空间中训练，那么去掉 REPA 才是合乎逻辑的做法。

sents.en: But turns out, it still unlocks better generations in RAE v2.
sents.zh: 但事实证明，它在 RAE v2 中仍能带来更好的生成效果。

sents.en: Let's pause for a second. That's really weird.
sents.zh: 让我们先停一下。这真的很奇怪。

paragraphs.en: The authors find that REPA reduces to x-prediction within RAE v2, because the DiT's latent space and the alignment loss are both derived from DINO. Obviously, this rhymes with our JiT-DDT; we're also doing x-prediction early in our DiT via our encoder. But, we think this points at a deeper point — the DiT has a gradient propagation problem.
paragraphs.zh: 作者发现，在 RAE v2 中，REPA 可以归约为 x-prediction，因为 DiT 的潜在空间和对齐损失都源自 DINO。 显然，这与我们的 JiT-DDT 相呼应；我们也是通过编码器在 DiT 的早期阶段进行 x-prediction。 但我们认为，这指向了一个更深层次的问题——DiT 存在梯度传播问题。

sents.en: The authors find that REPA reduces to x-prediction within RAE v2, because the DiT's latent space and the alignment loss are both derived from DINO.
sents.zh: 作者发现，在 RAE v2 中，REPA 可以归约为 x-prediction，因为 DiT 的潜在空间和对齐损失都源自 DINO。

sents.en: Obviously, this rhymes with our JiT-DDT; we're also doing x-prediction early in our DiT via our encoder.
sents.zh: 显然，这与我们的 JiT-DDT 相呼应；我们也是通过编码器在 DiT 的早期阶段进行 x-prediction。

sents.en: But, we think this points at a deeper point — the DiT has a gradient propagation problem.
sents.zh: 但我们认为，这指向了一个更深层次的问题——DiT 存在梯度传播问题。

paragraphs.en: Self-Flow in latent space, RAE v2 in DINO space, and JiT-DDT in pixel space all improve model performance by introducing a loss term earlier in the network. It seems like all these models need additional gradient highways to learn more effectively. We're actively digging into this and will report back on this soon.
paragraphs.zh: 潜空间中的 Self-Flow、DINO 空间中的 RAE v2 以及像素空间中的 JiT-DDT，都是通过在网络较早的位置引入一个损失项来提升模型性能的。 看起来这些模型都需要额外的梯度高速公路才能更有效地学习。 我们正在积极深入研究这一点，并将很快汇报相关进展。

sents.en: We're actively digging into this and will report back on this soon.

sents.zh: 浓重的黑色勾勒出身体和腿部，而涂抹的灰色调在马蹄周围暗示出尘土与动感。

sents.en: The background is left mostly untouched with a few sweeping gestural marks.
sents.zh: 背景基本保持空白，仅点缀着几处大幅度的即兴笔触。

sents.en: The drawing feels raw and immediate, with visible finger smudges.
sents.zh: 这幅画给人原始而直接的感觉，上面可见手指涂抹的痕迹。

paragraphs.en: A middle-aged Asian chef in a white double-breasted jacket tosses vegetables in a flaming wok, positioned center-left in a busy stainless-steel restaurant kitchen. Orange flames leap from the pan and light his focused face from below, while cool blue fluorescent light fills the background. Steam and small sparks scatter across the frame. Shot at a slight low angle with a fast shutter that freezes the tumbling vegetables mid-air.
paragraphs.zh: 一位身穿白色双排扣厨师服的中年亚洲厨师在火焰腾腾的炒锅中颠炒蔬菜，位于繁忙的不锈钢餐厅厨房的中央偏左位置。 橙色火苗从锅中跃起，自下而上照亮他专注的脸庞，而背景则充满冷蓝色的荧光灯光。 蒸汽和小火星散布在整个画面中。 以轻微仰角、高速快门拍摄，将空中翻滚的蔬菜定格在半空中。

paragraphs.en: Sweeping orange sand dunes stretch to the horizon under a clear sky at sunrise, with a sharp crest running diagonally from the lower left to the upper right of the frame. Low sunlight from the right carves the dunes into bright ridges and deep purple shadows. Fine wind-blown ripples texture the sand in the foreground. A lone line of camel tracks curves over the nearest dune toward the distance.
paragraphs.zh: 日出时分，澄澈的天空下，辽阔的橙色沙丘绵延至地平线，一道锐利的沙脊自画面左下角斜向延伸至右上角。 来自右侧的低角度阳光将沙丘雕刻成明亮的脊线和深紫色的阴影。 风吹形成的细密波纹为前景的沙地增添了质感。 一行孤独的骆驼足迹蜿蜒越过最近的沙丘，伸向远方。

paragraphs.en: A weathered elderly fisherman with a white beard and deep sun-creased wrinkles sits on the edge of a wooden dock, framed from the chest up and slightly right of center. He wears a faded navy knit cap and a yellow oilskin jacket and looks off to the left with pale blue eyes. Golden late-afternoon light rakes across his face from the left, catching the texture of his skin and beard. A calm harbor with moored boats blurs softly into the background.
paragraphs.zh: 一位饱经风霜的年长渔民留着白胡子，脸上布满深深晒出的皱纹，他坐在木质码头的边缘，画面取其胸部以上，位于画面中心略偏右的位置。 他头戴一顶褪色的藏青色针织帽，身穿黄色油布夹克，淡蓝色的眼睛望向左侧。 金色的午后余晖从左侧斜照在他的脸上，映衬出他皮肤和胡须的质感。 一个停泊着船只的平静海港在背景中柔和地虚化。

Buckets of tulips, roses, and sunflowers crowd the foreground in the lower third, and shelves of potted plants fill the background. Soft daylight from a storefront window on the right falls across her face and the pale pink petals. The depth of field is shallow, keeping her and the bouquet sharp.
paragraphs.zh: 一位面带微笑的中年女子系着绿色帆布围裙，在一家小花店的柜台后整理一束牡丹和桉树叶花束，画面取腰部以上居中构图。 郁金香、玫瑰和向日葵的花桶挤满画面下三分之一的前景，背景里摆满盆栽植物的货架。 来自右侧橱窗的柔和日光洒落在她的脸庞和淡粉色的花瓣上。 景深较浅，使她和花束保持清晰。

paragraphs.en: A shaggy Highland cow with long ginger hair covering its eyes and wide curved horns stands in a misty green Scottish field, framed from the chest up and centered, looking toward the viewer. Soft overcast light gives the fur a warm, tactile quality. Rolling hills and a low stone wall fade into fog behind it. Dew glistens on the grass in the foreground and the cow's wet nose catches a small highlight.
paragraphs.zh: 一头毛茸茸的高地牛站在雾气弥漫的苏格兰绿色田野中，长长的姜黄色毛发遮住双眼，弯角宽阔，画面取胸部以上并居中构图，牛望向观者。 柔和的阴天光线让牛毛呈现出温暖而富有质感的触感。 起伏的丘陵和一道低矮的石墙在它身后渐渐隐入雾中。 前景的草叶上闪着露珠，牛湿润的鼻头上掠过一点小小的高光。

paragraphs.en: Dozens of colorful hot-air balloons in stripes of red, yellow, blue, and green drift over a misty valley at dawn, with the largest balloon filling the upper left of the frame and the others scattered toward the horizon. Low sunlight from the right rims the balloons in warm gold. Rounded rock formations and green fields sit below, partly hidden by mist. The sky is a pale wash of peach and lavender.
paragraphs.zh: 数十个色彩缤纷的热气球有着红、黄、蓝、绿的条纹，在黎明时分漂浮在雾气缭绕的山谷上空，其中最大的气球占据画面左上方，其余气球散布在地平线附近。 右侧低垂的阳光为气球镶上温暖的金色轮廓。 下方是圆润的岩石地貌和绿色的田野，部分被雾气遮掩。 天空呈现淡桃色与薰衣草色的柔和晕染。

paragraphs.en: A Roman-style mosaic of a large fish swimming to the left, composed of thousands of small tesserae tiles in blues, greens, gold, and terracotta, filling the frame against a background of pale stone tiles. The fish's scales are picked out with alternating light and dark tiles, and a wavy band of blue tiles runs along the bottom. Grout lines and slight irregularities in the tile edges are visible. Even, diffuse light shows the surface texture.
paragraphs.zh: 一幅罗马风格的马赛克镶嵌画，一条大鱼向左游动，由数千块蓝色、绿色、金色和赤陶色的小镶嵌片组成，铺满整个画面，背景为浅色石材镶嵌片。 鱼的鳞片用明暗交替的镶嵌片勾勒出来，底部有一条由蓝色镶嵌片组成的波浪形饰带。 可以看到填缝线条以及镶嵌片边缘的轻微不规则之处。 均匀的漫射光展现出表面质感。

Small purple sea fans and yellow coral polyps frame the edges.

Torn sails and rigging strain in the wind, and a break in the dark clouds on the upper right lets a shaft of pale light fall on the foam. Thick impasto brushstrokes render the spray and cloud. The palette is deep blues, grays, and bone whites.

Fine cross-hatching builds up the deep wrinkles around his eyes and the texture of his short beard, while lighter strokes suggest a flat cap. The left side of the face is shaded in darker tones and the right fades into untouched paper. A few faint construction lines remain visible near the edges.
paragraphs.zh: 一幅老人面部四分之三视角的精细石墨铅笔素描，取景自肩部以上，构图居中于米白色纸张上。 细密的交叉排线塑造出他眼周深深的皱纹和短胡须的质感，而较轻的笔触勾勒出一顶平顶帽。 面部左侧以较深的色调绘制阴影，右侧则渐渐隐入未曾着色的纸面。 边缘附近仍可见几条淡淡的定位辅助线。

sents.en: A detailed graphite pencil sketch of an old man's face in three-quarter view, framed from the shoulders up and centered on cream-colored paper.
sents.zh: 一幅老人面部四分之三视角的精细石墨铅笔素描，取景自肩部以上，构图居中于米白色纸张上。

sents.en: Fine cross-hatching builds up the deep wrinkles around his eyes and the texture of his short beard, while lighter strokes suggest a flat cap.
sents.zh: 细密的交叉排线塑造出他眼周深深的皱纹和短胡须的质感，而较轻的笔触勾勒出一顶平顶帽。

sents.en: The left side of the face is shaded in darker tones and the right fades into untouched paper.
sents.zh: 面部左侧以较深的色调绘制阴影，右侧则渐渐隐入未曾着色的纸面。

sents.en: A few faint construction lines remain visible near the edges.
sents.zh: 边缘附近仍可见几条淡淡的定位辅助线。

paragraphs.en: A steaming bowl of tonkotsu ramen sits centered on a dark wooden counter, viewed from a slight high angle, with slices of pork belly, a soft-boiled egg halved to show its orange yolk, green onions, and a sheet of nori arranged on top of the noodles. Wooden chopsticks rest across the rim on the right. Steam rises and catches a warm overhead light. The cloudy broth and glistening pork are rendered in sharp, appetizing detail.
paragraphs.zh: 一碗热气腾腾的豚骨拉面放在深色木质吧台的中央，视角略微俯视，面条上铺着几片五花肉、一个溏心蛋（对半切开，露出橙黄色的蛋黄）、葱花和一片海苔。 一双木筷搭在右侧碗沿上。 蒸汽袅袅升起，映在温暖的顶灯下。 浑浊的汤底和油亮的五花肉以清晰诱人的细节呈现。

paragraphs.en: A vintage red bicycle with a wicker basket of fresh baguettes leans against a sun-bleached yellow plaster wall, positioned center-right in the frame. A green wooden window shutter and a small pot of red geraniums sit on the sill above the bike on the left. Bright afternoon sunlight from the right casts a crisp shadow of the bicycle across the wall and the cobblestones. The colors are warm and saturated.
paragraphs.zh: 一辆复古红色自行车斜靠在被阳光晒得发白的黄色灰泥墙上，车筐里装满新鲜法棍面包，位于画面中央偏右的位置。 左侧自行车上方，一扇绿色木制百叶窗和一小盆红色天竺葵摆放在窗台上。 右侧明媚的午后阳光在墙上和鹅卵石地面上投下自行车轮廓清晰的影子。 色彩温暖而浓郁。

paragraphs.en: A bearded street musician in a brown corduroy jacket plays a saxophone beneath a dripping awning on a rainy city street at dusk, positioned right of center. Neon signs in pink and teal reflect in the wet pavement in the lower half of the frame, and blurred pedestrians with umbrellas pass on the left. Cool ambient light mixes with a warm glow from a shop window behind him. Raindrops streak across the foreground.
paragraphs.zh: 黄昏时分，在雨中的城市街道上，一名身穿棕色灯芯绒夹克的络腮胡街头乐手在一处滴水的遮阳篷下吹奏萨克斯，位于画面中偏右的位置。 画面下半部分，粉色和青绿色的霓虹灯招牌映照在湿漉漉的人行道上，模糊的撑伞行人在左侧经过。 冷色的环境光与身后商店橱窗透出的温暖光芒交织在一起。 雨滴在前景中划出道道痕迹。

paragraphs.en: A macro photograph of a bright green tree frog with orange toes and red eyes perched on a floating lily pad, centered in the frame and viewed at water level. Dew drops bead on its glossy skin and the leaf's surface. Soft, diffused morning light gives an even glow, and the pond behind dissolves into a smooth green and blue bokeh. A single pink water lily blooms softly out of focus in the upper right.
paragraphs.zh: 一张微距摄影照片：一只鲜绿色的树蛙，脚趾呈橙色、眼睛呈红色，栖息在一片漂浮的睡莲叶上，位于画面中心，以水面平视角度拍摄。 露珠在其光亮的皮肤和叶片表面上凝结成珠。 柔和的漫射晨光带来均匀的光泽，背后的池塘融化为平滑的绿色与蓝色散景。 一朵粉色睡莲在画面右上方柔和绽放，处于焦外虚化中。

paragraphs.en: A vintage silver and black film camera rests on a scuffed oak desk beside a stack of faded photographs and a coiled leather strap, centered in the frame and viewed from a slight high angle. Warm afternoon light from a window on the left glints along the chrome dials and lens ring. A half-empty cup of black coffee sits out of focus in the upper right. The shallow depth of field keeps the lens crisp while the desk edge softens.
paragraphs.zh: 一台复古的银黑双色胶片相机放在一张布满磨损痕迹的橡木书桌上，旁边是一叠褪色的照片和一根盘绕的皮质背带，相机位于画面中央，视角为略微俯视。 来自左侧窗户的午后暖光在镀铬旋钮和镜头环上闪着微光。 画面右上方有一杯半满的黑咖啡，处于失焦状态。 浅景深让镜头保持清晰锐利，而书桌边缘则显得柔和模糊。
